articles.title: Infiltration bid foiled, terror module busted in Jammu
articles.summary: Reports indicate King Charles' brother, former Prince Andrew, has been arrested in connection with the 'Epstein Files' over alleged misconduct. This significant development follows long-standing scrutiny related to the high-profile case. SSB aspirants should note its international implications regarding royal family conduct and legal accountability, a key topic for current affairs awareness.

articles.title: Garden Reach Shipbuilders set for Navratna status as DPE clears proposal, final nod awaited
articles.summary: The Department of Public Enterprises (DPE) has granted 'Navratna' status to state-run shipbuilder Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd (GRSE). This prestigious designation provides GRSE with significantly increased financial and operational autonomy, enabling greater investment without direct government approval. This strategic upgrade enhances GRSE's capability to contribute to India's naval defence and maritime infrastructure, reinforcing its vital role in national security.

articles.title: A Guide to the Comics That Have Inspired James Gunn’s DC Universe
articles.summary: Filmmaker James Gunn's early recommendations for DC works surprisingly highlighted Alan Moore's 'Top 10' comic run, alongside titles like 'Swamp Thing'. This selection stood out as a particularly unexpected choice among his suggested readings. The mention underlines the diverse and sometimes unconventional influences potentially guiding future projects within the DC universe's expansive narrative landscape.

articles.title: Les Wexner: How the billionaire enabled Jeffrey Epstein’s rise
articles.summary: US lawmakers conducted a closed-door session in Ohio, questioning billionaire Leslie Wexner regarding Jeffrey Epstein's controversial rise to wealth and influence. The inquiry delved into Wexner's past associations with Epstein and his potential involvement or knowledge of the disgraced financier's operations, aiming for transparency among powerful figures in American society.

articles.title: Army foils infiltration bid along LoC in Rajouri
articles.summary: Alert Indian Army troops successfully scuttled a terrorist infiltration attempt along the Line of Control (LoC) in Jammu and Kashmir's Rajouri district on Thursday. This swift action highlights the army's constant vigilance and effectiveness in maintaining border security. Such operations are crucial for protecting national sovereignty and demonstrate the unwavering dedication of our forces against external threats.

articles.title: Starlink loss a blow to Russian forces in Ukraine: experts
articles.summary: Elon Musk's Starlink has cut Russian access to its satellites over Ukraine, likely disrupting Russian communication and operational capabilities amidst the ongoing conflict. This strategic move by the US tech titan highlights the significant role of private satellite technology in modern warfare, impacting military operations on the ground and showcasing technology's dual-use nature.

articles.title: scpn-control added to PyPI
articles.summary: "scpn-control" is a neuro-symbolic engine converting Stochastic Petri Nets into formally verified spiking neural network controllers. This innovation creates highly reliable, provably correct AI-based control systems. It's vital for developing dependable autonomous platforms in defence, aerospace, and robotics, ensuring precision and safety for critical missions.

articles.title: interface.ai Launches Smart Collections - An Agentic, Multi-Channel Collections AI Agent Built for Credit Unions and Community Banks to Increase Payments
articles.summary: interface.ai, a leading provider of specialized AI agents for credit unions and community banks, launched 'Smart Collections' on Feb 19, 2026. This new AI-powered solution from Palo Alto, California, aims to optimize financial operations. It highlights the increasing role of artificial intelligence in enhancing efficiency and customer engagement within the banking sector, signifying advancements in fintech.
